pages.title: Mana Engineering
pages.text: Mana need not live only in you. Bound in metal and amethyst, it can be stored, carried and spent by the world itself.$(br2)A $(l)Mana Battery$() holds 2000 mana. $(l)Right-click$() it to open it: store or draw mana in tens, fifties, or all at once. Sneak and right-click to pour in 50 without opening it.

Place a $(item)Mana Crystal$() in the battery's $(l)Charge$() slot and the battery fills it; place one in the $(l)Drain$() slot and the battery empties it. A comparator reads how full the battery is.$(br2)$(o)Break a battery and its mana spills away, though any crystals inside are kept. Empty it first.$()

$(l)Mana Conduits$() carry mana between blocks. They join to any neighbouring conduit, battery or lantern automatically.$(br2)A $(l)Warding Lantern$() draws mana through conduits (or straight from a battery beside it). While lit, it stops monsters from appearing within $(l)24 blocks$(). It sips one point of mana every three seconds.$(br2)Lanterns do not stop monster spawners.
